SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2 Special Branch
REPORT
Date January 12, 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File & B. REGISTRY.
No. D 56/3
Date 12/1/34）

Subject (in full) Mrs. Zosia C. Sutterle nee Yelowitsky.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by A.9. [签名]

With reference to the attached letter dated January 6,
1934, from the Netherlands Consulate-General on the subject
of Mrs. Zosia C. Sutterle nee Yelowitsky alias Elovitsky,
enquiries show that Mrs. Sutterle was born on January 28, 1902
at Gitonin, Poland. She has not, however, been registered
with the local Polish Consulate as a Polish citizen.
During 1917/18 she resided in Habarovsk, Siberia, with
her relation - as Inspector of the Habarovsk Police, and his
family. In 1919 she left for Vladivostok where her father
kept a flower garden. There she received employment as a
nurse. It is reported that during this time she married a
Serbian officer who, shortly afterwards was killed during an
uprising in the Maritime Province. In 1921 or 1922 she came
to Shanghai and was again employed as a nurse. Some time
later, she made the acquaintance of Frederick W. Sutterle, an
elderly and wealthy American, who is President of the China
Realty Co., No. 70 Szechuen Road (File D.1242). She cohabited
with him for a few years and on August 28, 1924, they were
married in Chicago, U.S.A. Mrs. Sutterle is known in Shanghai
as a lady who lives a life of luxury. She is interested in
Dramatic Art and has organised amateur theatrical performances
for charity. She has also undertaken benevolent work. Mrs.
Sutterle has made several trips to Europe and has visited
Swiss resorts for the benefit of her health. About a year
ago, she separated from her husband. It is rumoured that
she has refused to divorce him as she is not satisfied with
the allowance settled upon her.
The mother and sister of Mrs. Sutterle are living in
Shanghai. Mrs. Sutterle resides at No. 1884 Avenue Joffre.

报告
日期：1934年1月12日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案及B类登记处。
编号 D 56/3
日期 1934年1月12日）

事由（全称）：佐西娅·C·萨特勒夫人（Mrs. Zosia C. Sutterle），娘家姓耶洛维茨基（Yelowitsky）。

制作人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky） 转呈人：A.9. [签名]

关于随附的荷兰总领事馆1934年1月6日来信，涉及佐西娅·C·萨特勒夫人（娘家姓耶洛维茨基，又名埃洛维茨基 Elovitsky）一事，经查询，萨特勒夫人于1902年1月28日出生于波兰吉托宁（Gitonin）。然而，她并未在当地波兰领事馆注册为波兰公民。1917/18年间，她与一名亲属——哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）警察督察及其家人——居住在西伯利亚的哈巴罗夫斯克。1919年，她前往海参崴（Vladivostok），其父在那里经营一处花圃。她在那里受雇担任护士。据报，在此期间她嫁给了一名塞尔维亚军官，该军官不久后在滨海省（Maritime Province）的一次起义中丧生。1921年或1922年，她来到上海，再次受雇担任护士。不久后，她结识了弗雷德里克·W·萨特勒（Frederick W. Sutterle），一位年迈且富有的美国人，他是四川路70号中国置业公司（China Realty Co.）的总裁（档案 D.1242）。她与萨特勒同居数年，并于1924年8月28日在美国芝加哥结婚。萨特勒夫人在上海以生活奢华的女士闻名。她对戏剧艺术感兴趣，并组织过业余戏剧演出以进行慈善活动。她还从事过仁慈救济工作。萨特勒夫人曾多次前往欧洲，并为了健康缘故去过瑞士的疗养胜地。大约一年前，她与丈夫分居。有传言称，由于对商定的赡养费不满意，她拒绝与其离婚。
萨特勒夫人的母亲和妹妹居住在上海。萨特勒夫人现居霞飞路1884号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5613
Date 8 / 1 / 34

SHANGHAI, 6 January 1934 .

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mrs. Zosia Y
Sutterle née Yelowitski, born at Gitonin, Poland, 28
January 1902, who was married to Frederick W. Sutterle, an
American citizen on 22 August 1924 in Chicago, has applied
for a visa for admission into Hungary.

Through the above marriage Mrs. Sutterle lost her
Polish nationality but did not acquire American citizen-
ship. She travels on a declaration sworn before the local
American Consulate General on 20 July 1933.

From similar declarations in her possession it would
appear that she travels rather extensively.

Her present address is at 1884 Ave Joffre.

I should be much obliged to you if you would kindly
inform me whether anything is known against her from a
political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：* To previous record.）
（批：* See file D1242.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. B. 登记处。
编号 D 5613
日期 1934年1月8日

上海，1934年1月6日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，佐西娅·Y·萨特勒夫人（Mrs. Zosia Y Sutterle），娘家姓耶洛维茨基（Yelowitski），1902年1月28日出生于波兰吉托宁（Gitonin），于1924年8月22日在芝加哥与美国公民弗雷德里克·W·萨特勒（Frederick W. Sutterle）结婚，现已申请进入匈牙利的签证。

通过上述婚姻，萨特勒夫人失去了波兰国籍，但未获得美国公民身份。她持有一份于1933年7月20日在当地美国总领事馆面前宣誓的声明书旅行。

从她持有的类似声明书来看，她似乎经常广泛旅行。

她目前的地址是霞飞路1884号。

如蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否掌握任何关于她的不利情况，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，
[签名]
中文秘书。

致：
T. P. 吉文斯（T. P. Givens）先生，
特别股主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注：* 归入先前记录。）
（批注：* 参见档案 D1242。）

S. 2
